Enclosure and Structural Designer said about it: The table in Professional Manufacturer Factory Keep Warm Insulated PU Sandwich Panel (E32) gives U Value PIR 0.21 watt per square metre kelvin at 100 millimetre and 0.17 watt per square metre kelvin at 120 millimetre, and the comparison in Sandwich Panel Types: PU, PIR, EPS & Rock Wool Compared (E33) states 100 millimetre Polyurethane (PU, foam insulation) reaches about 0.23 watt per square metre kelvin, so I use Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) 100 millimetre walls and 120 millimetre roof and floor at about 0.21 watt per square metre kelvin.
